common_name: Polka-Dotted 16-Spot Wing Fly (Wingless Morphogen Induction of Yellow Melanin Spots)
anatomical_structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Drosophila guttifera (2.1 µm, detail scale)

predecessor.note: Hawaiian picture-wing. At this 2.12 µm tier the melanin field is vein-locked lacework, represented by diffusion anisotropy 3.15, not by the 199 µm sibling-slot wavelength.

successor.note: Hawaiian picture-wing hammerhead. At this tier the model removes the campaniform Gaussian and raises basal activator production from 0.10 to 0.24. Spieth 1981 measures head shape, not this wavelength.

equations.schnakenberg: du/dt = Du * laplacian(u) + a - u + u^2 v; dv/dt = Dv * laplacian(v) + b - u^2 v
equations.marginal_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (Dv f_u + Du g_v) / (2 Du Dv)
equations.growth_rate: sigma(k) = 0.5 * (tau + sqrt(tau^2 - 4 Delta)); tau = f_u + g_v - k^2 (Du + Dv); Delta = det(J) - k^2 (Dv f_u + Du g_v) + k^4 Du Dv
equations.selected_wavelength: lambda = 2 pi / k_max, k_max = argmax sigma(k). Spatial unit is chosen so lambda(k_max) at the focal parameters equals 2.12e-6 m.
equations.wingless_prepattern: a(x) = a0 + a_w exp(-r^2 / (2 s^2)) at one campaniform sensillum (guttifera morphology run only)

boundary_conditions.primary: Periodic boundaries on the wavelength sweep and the morphology fields, integrated in Fourier space.
boundary_conditions.neumann_control: Explicit reflecting (zero-flux) Laplacian on a 48 by 48 grid. Reported as a control wavelength, not substituted for the periodic sweep.

parameters.notes: Dimensionless diffusivities. Physical length is fixed by requiring the focal linear wavelength 2 pi / k_max to equal 2.12 µm. These numbers are not copied from the 102 µm guttifera slot or the 199 µm grimshawi slot.

empirical_claims.claim: Wingless protein at vein intersections and campaniform sensilla induces yellow melanin spots on the D. guttifera wing, via a derived cis-regulatory input.
empirical_claims.used_as: Prepattern geometry (punctate Wingless sources), not as a measured 2.12 µm wavelength.

empirical_claims.claim: wingless is expressed in specific cell types of campaniform sensilla on the pupal wing.
empirical_claims.used_as: Single-sensillum Gaussian nucleator inside the micro-patch.

empirical_claims.claim: Yellow wing spots of D. guttifera pigment during a defined pupal window.
empirical_claims.used_as: Developmental reading of the animation, not a clock parameter.

empirical_claims.claim: A reaction-diffusion system selects a finite critical wavenumber k_c.
empirical_claims.used_as: Dispersion relation implemented in the script and in Loop_3187.

does_not_claim: Werner et al. 2010 did not publish this Schnakenberg system and did not measure a 2.12 µm pigment wavelength.
The 16 macroscopic wing spots live at a much larger scale (sibling slot 3011). This patch is the interior of one Wingless-induced spot.
D. grimshawi anisotropy 3.15 and D. heteroneura basal activator 0.24 are reconstructed contrasts between chronospecies, not laboratory diffusion coefficients.
Spieth 1981 is a head-shape and behavior paper. It is not a wing-wavelength measurement.
The terminal animation frame is the adult specimen photograph. The generative field is the preceding frames and the comparison figure. A 2.12 µm pattern is below the resolution of that photograph.
